snippet.title: Order:The New Dawn - Official Gameplay Reveal
snippet.description:
Get a look at some Order:The New Dawn gameplay in the latest trailer!

Order: The New Dawn is a colony sim with space adventure. Step into the role of a legendary captain and lead your elite team to forge an epic tale on the desert planet of New Terra.
You are a legendary captain from the United Stellar. While leading your team to suppress a galaxy-spanning rebellion, you’re pulled into the Initial Rift—an isolated star region lost to time.
Here, the last known civilization—the Terra Kingdom—has long fallen. Its homeworld destroyed two centuries ago, its people now scattered across broken worlds: surviving in hiding, raiding for scraps, or clinging to fading strongholds.
Will you rebuild order, watch it crumble, or plunge the stars into deeper chaos?
Harness advanced United Stellar technology to gather resources, unlock research, and expand your domain.
Design your base room by room. Assemble space fleets. Construct planetary hubs and system-spanning mega structures.
Explore scorching deserts, frozen tundras, volcanic wastelands, ruined ground cities, orbital relics—and twisted alien hives choked in bio-contamination.
The fate of the Waste space begins with your first outpost.
